UserWorkspace.title: UserWorkspace
UserWorkspace.description: Per-user WelcomeRO preferences, onboarding profile, checklist progress, document ticks, and arrival plan dates.

ownerId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID owning this workspace document.

hasProfile.description: True when the user has completed onboarding.

profile.description: Onboarding profile object with situation, citizenship, accommodation, and completed list.

progress.description: Map of procedure IDs to status (not-started, in-progress, completed).

docs.description: Map of procedure IDs to arrays of checked document names.

dates.description: Plan dates object containing arrival and expiry ISO date strings.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest sync.

/users/{userId}.description: Private single-owner workspace document storing WelcomeRO onboarding answers, checklist progress, document readiness, and timeline dates without PII.
